name: kilsta-business-ict
description: KILSTA Business & ICT Consultants - production monorepo (React/Vite frontend, Express API, Supabase PostgreSQL)

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.lint: npm --workspace server run lint && npm --workspace client run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace server run test:run && npm --workspace client run test:run
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
